blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY – The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has suspended the environmental compliance certificate (ECC) of a small-scale coal mining project in Barangay Obi, Caramoran, Catanduanes, following violations of regulations, including unauthorized clearing operations outside its permitted area. In a November 25 letter, DENR Region V Director Geri-Gerónimo Sañez informed project proponent Adelbert Z. Almario that the ECC had been frozen until the violations are addressed. The suspension followed an Oct. 11 inspection by the Environmental Management Bureau (EMB) in Region V, which determined that the project failed to comply with the ECC conditions.
